dates.prior_version_note: RSO allowable annual increase was already in force earlier (rent increases were frozen 2020-03-30 through 2024-01-31); the 2026-02-02 revision removed the utilities add-on and the 10% dependent add-on, and the percentage is reset each July 1 (3% for 7/1/2025-6/30/2026).

Just-cause provisions of the RSO predate the documents; later additions include the FMR non-payment limit (2023-03-27) and Right to Counsel posting (2025-08-20), but the original start date is not stated.
JCO original effective date not stated in the documents; the FMR non-payment limit was added 2023-03-27.
Relocation assistance for no-fault evictions already applied under the RSO/JCO; amounts are adjusted every July 1 (prior period 7/1/2025-6/30/2026).
RPO codified and expanded HCA (SB 330) relocation protections that already applied; the RPO standardized payment amounts are updated each July 1 (current figures effective 2026-07-01).
Interest rate is reset annually by the City (e.g., 0.520% for 2024, 4.320% for 2025), but the requirement itself has applied since 1990.

in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: Interest shall begin accruing on November 1, 1990, on a monthly basis.
